options.label: Most loans (times borrowed)
options.hint: Rank books by how many loans they have: COUNT of rows in loans per book, highest first.

options.label: Most different borrowers
options.hint: Rank books by the number of distinct members who borrowed them: COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) in loans per book.

options.label: Highest average rating
options.hint: Rank books by AVG(rating) from reviews, considering only books with at least 3 reviews.

options.label: Most loans overall
options.hint: Rank members by their total number of loans (COUNT of rows in loans per member).

options.label: Most different books borrowed
options.hint: Rank members by COUNT(DISTINCT book_id) in loans per member.

options.label: Most loans in the last 90 days
options.hint: Rank members by number of loans whose loaned_on is within the 90 days up to TODAY.

options.label: The last 7 days
options.hint: Treat "recent" as the 7 days up to and including TODAY (date >= date(TODAY, '-7 day')).

options.label: The last 30 days
options.hint: Treat "recent" as the 30 days up to and including TODAY (date >= date(TODAY, '-30 day')).

options.label: The last 90 days
options.hint: Treat "recent" as the 90 days up to and including TODAY (date >= date(TODAY, '-90 day')).

options.label: Borrowed something in the last 30 days
options.hint: A member is active if they have a loan with loaned_on within the 30 days up to TODAY.

options.label: Currently has a book on loan
options.hint: A member is active if they have at least one loan with returned_on IS NULL.

options.label: Borrowed something in the last 90 days
options.hint: A member is active if they have a loan with loaned_on within the 90 days up to TODAY.
